description:
Order a report for a property. report_type 'current_owner' (default) = the title search report: `address` is
    the street address (house number, street, city, ZIP), `state` the two-letter code, `county` the county (or
    borough / city alias); only covered counties (check_coverage). report_type 'environmental' = the Environmental
    Records Report for any US street address: give the full address with city and state; `state` and `county` are not
    needed (they come from the Census geocoder). Returns an order_id; then poll get_order_status every ~20 seconds
    until status is 'complete' (usually 1 to 3 minutes) and call get_report. Costs $49 for a title search and $29 for an
    Environmental Records Report. `email` is optional (used only for the report link; nothing is sent while email delivery is off).
name: order_title_search
